items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 32:1
items.html: The Mazal that became the Daat of Arich Anpin, which couples its Hesed and Gevura that ascended and became Hochma and Bina, as in Item 29 above, is called the upper Daat of Arich Anpin. This is because it has no coupling in the head of Arich Anpin after Arich Anpin descends to its place, as in Answers 30 and 28 above. (Mevo Shearim, Gate 3, Part 2, Chapter 1; Page 446, Item 16).
